evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; speech coded from burned-in phrase captions (hook at 4 fps, rest at 1 fps, so some words may be missed). Film clips identified from my own recognition of the pictures (The Wolf of Wall Street, The Big Lebowski, Office Space, Whiplash), not from any text on screen. Sound not heard. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: What separates rich from poor is what they do with free time: poor people watch TV and scroll social media, rich people invest in health, education, business and personal development; he tells viewers to choose the people they follow and, in a comment-keyword CTA, to get a special episode.
audience: his followers, people who want to get rich or change habits
caption_vs_video_note: Caption matches the video (rich vs poor free time) and adds the CTA 'comment the word עשיר' for an episode that does not appear in the video; the video itself has no spoken CTA (the last frames end on 'how to do this too').

opening.first_frame: Matan in a black short-sleeve shirt seated in a premium airline cabin (warm ceiling lights, leather seat), holding a small recorder, looking at the camera; caption 'אחד הדברים המרכזיים'.
opening.s0_1: Caption 'אחד הדברים המרכזיים' holds from 0 to 1 s over the selfie shot (he starts mid-thought).
opening.s1_3: At 1 s a split-screen of two film clips: a man in a suit counting a banknote with green label 'עשירים' above and a man in a bathrobe with a milk jug and red label 'עניים' below; back to him at 2.5 s with 'זה מה שהם עושים'.
opening.s3_5: 'עם הזמן הפנוי שלהם!' (3.25 to 4 s) then 'אנשים עניים' (4.25 s).
opening.visual_hook: Split-screen of two film characters labelled rich and poor.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s (machine transcript): 'אחד הדברים המרכזיים שמבדילים בין העשירים לעניים זה מה שהם עושים עם הזמן הפנוי שלהם'; matches the captions
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 4.25 s (he answers what poor people do right after the claim)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'one of the central things that separates rich from poor is what they do with their free time' is a complete claim, though the first caption shows only 'אחד הדברים המרכזיים'
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: no (a banknote appears in the film clip at 1 to 2 s)
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions plus the labelled split-screen carry it

visual.subject_placement: Selfie, head and torso centred, recorder in his right hand, captions at about 60% of the frame.
visual.setting: A business-class airline cabin; inserts from film scenes, a social feed scroll, TV viewers, travel and yacht footage, a gaming clip, an airline cabin crew shot, the Maldives from air, a yacht.
visual.lighting: Warm cabin lights; saturated colour on inserts.
visual.color_contrast: Black shirt against warm cream and amber; white captions with black outline, green words for rich-side lines, red for poor-side or warning words.
visual.props_and_gestures: A small audio recorder as a mic, pointing hand, thumbs, palms up.
visual.supporting_footage: Wolf of Wall Street and Big Lebowski stills as a split screen (1 to 2.5 s), a reality TV clip of viewers on a sofa (7 s), a hand scrolling a feed (8 to 9 s), own lifestyle clips (boat with his partner at 18 s, a mountain with a cup of coffee at 19 to 20 s, himself signing papers at a desk at 21 s), Office Space crowd clip (30 to 33 s), a gamer streamer clip (47 to 48 s), Whiplash drum clips with 'שנה', '3 שנים' (53 to 55 s), an Emirates first-class cabin with cabin crew (58 s), a Maldives aerial (59 s), a yacht deck (60 s).
visual.visual_progression: One cabin selfie shot from 0 s with an insert every 1 to 5 s; denser inserts from 30 s; returns to the selfie for the close at 56 to 67 s.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: cover is a selfie frame with the caption 'תבחרו את האנשים' (about 38 s).
visual.ui_interference: Captions at about 60%, clear of the zones; no text in the top 14% seen.

editing.edit_function: Illustration: nearly every phrase gets a matching clip (rich versus poor split-screen, TV viewers, scrolling, vacation scenes), keeping stimulation high on a static selfie.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 12s: a clip every 1 to 3 s
t=12 to 17s: a long selfie stretch of 5 s
t=30 to 33s: a continuous film clip
t=47 to 55s: gamer and drum clips
t=56 to 67s: mix of selfie and travel footage
editing.ending: Last 10 s: selfie with captions 'והחיים שלכם ישתנו מקצה לקצה!', 'ואתם תשנו ב-180 מעלות!', 'זה מה שאני עשיתי', 'והיום אני מלמד אתכם איך לעשות את זה גם!'.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the fast insert rhythm can be rewatched, but no specific reason to restart.

sound.delivery: Interpretation: speech is continuous and emphatic; loudness data show only the final 1.5 s as silence (-53 and -61 dB at 66.5 and 67 s), so the Reel ends right when he finishes talking.
sound.sfx: inferred: whoosh on the film split-screen and transitions
sound.sync: Captions change every 0.5 to 1 s in step with his speech, colour words (green and red) align with the rich and poor sides; each insert appears on the phrase naming it (e.g. 'גוללים ברשתות החברתיות' at 8 s).

text.colour_coding: White default; green for the rich side ('עשירים', 'אנשים עשירים', 'בבריאות שלהם', 'בהשכלה שלהם', 'בהתפתחות האישית', 'ואת האופי שלהם'); red for the poor side and warnings ('עניים', 'פשוט מבבזים', 'גוללים ברשתות החברתיות', 'ולא לעשות כמוהם!', 'את כל הזמן שיש להם!', 'הרוב תמיד טועה!').
text.placement: Centre at about 55 to 60%, one or two lines.
text.style: Bold Hebrew sans-serif with black outline, no background box.
text.density_and_read_time: 2 to 5 words per caption, changing every 1 to 2 s; easy.
text.language: Contrast phrases: 'אנשים עניים … פשוט מבזבזים', 'אנשים עשירים … משקיעים'; second person plural, imperatives ('תבחרו את האנשים'); one promise 'אני מבטיח לכם'.
text.caption_structure: Opening claim, two short bullet lists with emojis (poor: TV, news, scrolling; rich: health, education, business), then a CTA line to comment the word עשיר and receive the episode.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; parenthesis in '(עבורכם)' and exclamation marks sometimes appear on the wrong side; '180' renders correctly in 'ב180 מעלות!'.

story.setup: What separates rich from poor is what they do with their free time.
story.stakes: Which people you follow and copy decides your results.
story.progression: Poor people waste free time: TV, news and scrolling social media (4 to 11 s); rich people invest in health, education, relationships, personal development and above all their own business (11 to 26 s); the majority is always wrong about success (26 to 37 s); choose the people you follow and copy their results and character (38 to 44 s); build your future instead of wasting time (44 to 52 s); Whiplash illustrates years of practice.
story.payoff: Advice: choose your people, then invest one to three years in building your future ('הנה הדיל', about 53 to 57 s); promise that life changes from edge to edge and by 180 degrees.
story.resolution: Claims that it is what he did and what he teaches today.
friction_points: t=0 to 1s: starts mid-thought with a caption fragment
the spoken CTA is absent; the caption's CTA (comment עשיר) is not repeated in the video (interpretation)

conversion.benefit: Learning the habits of the rich (stated in the caption).
conversion.proof: His own lifestyle clips shown in the video.
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Visible in the caption: comment 'עשיר' to receive the episode; automation not verified here.
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the keyword equals the topic and the episode continues the theme
conversion.destination: not visible (the episode is sent to those who comment)

pair_match.notes: Comparison for DW_dpe4lGvB (Apr 2026, about 60 s, mindset talking head, per the dossier note); pair not opened. By the dossier description it is a similar mindset talking head.

rights_and_privacy: Heavy use of third-party film clips (Wolf of Wall Street, Big Lebowski, Office Space, Whiplash), a streamer video, an Emirates cabin crew clip and viral travel footage; the gamer's face and cabin crew are identifiable; limits what LumeBook can copy.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a self-contained rich-versus-poor claim shown as a labelled split screen in the first seconds, a dense visual illustration of each phrase, and a keyword CTA that fits the topic; 99 comments from 27K views (3.6 per 1K) are mostly keyword entries.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: reach is about 27K views, the topic and the film-clip style recur across his account, and the in-video CTA is missing, so the keyword prompt depends on the caption being read.
